# لُبّ (LUB / Lub)

> لُبّ مساحة طلابية تساعد طلاب كلية علوم الحاسب والمعلومات بجامعة الإمام محمد بن سعود الإسلامية على اكتشاف الأندية والمجالس والفعاليات المنشورة ومتابعة المشاركة والإنجازات. LUB is a student platform for the College of Computer and Information Sciences at Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University.

The Arabic brand name is written لُبّ and the Latin name is LUB (Lub). Visitors can browse public information without an account. Sign-in is needed when applying to join, registering for an event, or using personal student features. Use the linked public pages as the source of current LUB information; organization and event records may change.

## About LUB

- [About LUB / عن لُبّ](https://lub.community/#about): What LUB is, who it serves, and how to explore the public site.
- [Official College of Computer and Information Sciences website](https://units.imamu.edu.sa/colleges/ComputerAndInformation/Pages/default.aspx): Official academic and college information from Imam Mohammad Ibn Saud Islamic University.

## Public pages

- [Clubs and councils](https://lub.community/organizations): Published student clubs, councils, and organization profiles.
- [Events](https://lub.community/events): Published event information; sign-in is needed to register.
- [Talent](https://lub.community/talent): Student profiles and achievements that students chose to publish.
- [Ask LUB](https://lub.community/ai): Questions about public LUB content.
- [Visitor help](https://lub.community/help/visitor): How public browsing and account-required actions work.
